abstract: We establish support-restricted asymptotic density upper bounds strictly below 9/5 = 1.8 for the maximum size of a subset without three collinear points in four-level axis-aligned modular hyperbola unions across all center phases (x_0, y_0) in F_p^2 (Open Cell 10 of no_three_in_line_35 v8). In Version 1, 1D difference-phase binning certified 34 of the 57 collision isomorphism classes globally across [0, 1/2]^2. In Version 2, 2D root-difference phase binning extended global certification to 39 classes (100% of T(C) <= 3 plus (-4, -2, -1, 1)). In this Version 3, we incorporate all reviewer items from the v2 acceptance report and resolve 100% of all 57 collision isomorphism classes strictly below 1.8 on the universal interior peak square [13/40, 7/20]^2 (14 unsplit, 9 subdivided, worst-case bound 1.79986885 < 1.8). We prove Proposition 2 (Active-Root vs. Binned-Difference Tradeoff on C & D), establishing that 1D conditional independence requires |C_act| <= 4 - k_b because conditioning an active root changes its marginal distribution rather than coupling distinct roots. In Theorem 5, vertical reflection rho(x, y) = (x, p - 1 - y) preserves Euclidean collinearity and maps H_p(C; x_0, y_0) to H_p(-C; x_0, -1 - y_0), swapping (t_+, t_-) <-> (t_-, t_+) up to an O(1/p) shift bounded by 4/p via the finite-grid Lipschitz inequality. In Theorem 6, we establish the Unified Scalar Representation across both antipodal parity sheets sigma(A, B) in {0, 1}, proving pointwise nested root survival and first-order stochastic dominance under pure conditional mutual independence. Exact rational certificates verify all 5 target classes globally (136 interior cells, Theorem 7, Table 2) and certify all 23 remaining classes on the peak square [13/40, 7/20]^2 strictly below 1.8 (Theorem 8, Table 3), evaluated via 9-node Lagrange Gram matrix quadrature and bounded-cache memory management.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: This Version 3 incorporates all precision and memory improvements from the v2 acceptance report and completes peak-square sub-1.8 certification across 100% of all 57 collision isomorphism classes: (1) Replaced Proposition 2's proof wording with the exact marginal distribution explanation, clarifying that conditioning independent coordinates on separate bins preserves independence while changing the marginal distribution of active roots. (2) Refined Theorem 5 to note that rho(x, y) = (x, p - 1 - y) preserves Euclidean collinearity on the integer grid and that the O(1/p) phase displacement is bounded by 4/p via the finite-grid translation inequality [1, Eq. (Z5)], vanishing in the limsup. (3) Made explicit in Theorem 6 that the displayed root-pair tail integrals are conditional on I_u = 1, that active roots own their continuous coordinates while auxiliary differences are deterministically capped, and explicitly stated the short-segment non-negative bound. (4) Completed exact rational sub-1.8 certification for all 3 maximal-collision classes on [13/40, 7/20]^2 ((-4, -3, -2, -1) at 1.79954920 < 1.8 on 10 sub-cells, (-2, -1, 1, 2) at 1.79895226 < 1.8 on 3 sub-cells, and (-3, -2, -1, 1) at 1.79986885 < 1.8 on 28 sub-cells), establishing that 100% of all 57 collision classes satisfy max_ub < 1.8 on [13/40, 7/20]^2. (5) Integrated exact 9-node Lagrange Gram matrix quadrature and bounded-cache memory management clearing ev_2d_cache and GLOBAL_2D_CACHE between classes, ensuring peak RAM < 25 MB and reporting the exact stored interior cell count (136 cells).
title: Concentric-Threshold Equivalence, Diagonal Reflection Duality, Antipodal Parity Sheets, and All-Center Sub-9/5 Asymptotic Bounds for 39 Four-Hyperbola Classes Completing All T(C) <= 3 and Peak-Square Certification for All 57 Classes
